semiconductor_relevance: High — STRATEGIC provides critical measurement technologies essential for semiconductor quality and performance.
summary: STRATEGIC specializes in advanced equipment and measurement solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on particle monitors and analyzers for both airborne and liquid applications. They offer a range of spectrometers, including FTIR and ATR-FTIR, and provide services that support various stages of the semiconductor value chain, particularly in nanotechnology applications.
capabilities: Particle monitors and analyzers for airborne and liquid applications
Stress, refractive index, reflectivity, and conductivity measurement solutions
